P1 — Fixed-instance all-time lower-bound proof fails for its proposed finite-dimensional witness — Counterevidence and alternatives: For each horizon a different dimension and hard function can give a valid worst-case lower bound. That is not the printed existence-before-all-times assertion. A single strongly convex member does not by itself refute the existential theorem; the general convergence argument defeats the entire proposed attained finite-dimensional witness family.
